column_description: Primary key (VARCHAR(30)) for a buyer record (e.g., 'BUY-xyz890').
An INT specifying how many days the buyer has been active (e.g., 60).
A SMALLINT counting how many purchases/transactions the buyer made (e.g., 25).
An enum (BuySpending_enum) describing spending pattern (Variable, High, Low, Medium).
An enum (BuyFreqCat_enum) labeling purchase frequency (Heavy, Regular, One-time, Occasional).
An enum (BuyCheckLvl_enum) specifying buyer verification level (Advanced, Basic).
A NUMERIC(5,2) measure of fraud or chargeback risk for this buyer (e.g., 82.50).
FK referencing Markets(MktRegistry), linking buyer to its main or home market.
FK referencing Vendors(VendRegistry), if the buyer is directly associated with a vendor.
